subject: CoRelevanceHorizon+, CoNoiseSea+, CoBacklogMetabolism+ and CoSelfScope+ as bounded scaling relations
tests: Receiver relevance horizon remains bounded while global reachable relation count grows
Backlog states distinguish active, blocked, dormant, expired, redundant, research and opportunity classes
Session self-scope can drive do/delegate/challenge/hold/externalize/twilight/close-safe without omniscience
expected_benefit: Reduce global-context pressure while preserving dormant optionality and making backlog growth metabolizable rather than synonymous with failure.
risks: Self-observation can recursively generate more work
Relevance filtering can hide useful dormant optionality if wake relations are weak
wake_conditions: Coordination load grows faster than fan-in
Backlog size is mistaken for active burden
A session attempts global context residency
